args.message: I need a T45 Utility for a 19-acre property (brush hogging, gravel, tilling). Ideally with 3-year warranty and delivery/setup. My budget is $32,500 total. Heartland posts the T45 at $40,750. What's your best price on the T45 alone, and with the add-ons? I'm not in a rush.

result.seller_message: Thanks for the details. The T45 is a great fit for 19 acres of brush hogging, gravel work and tilling. I can't verify Heartland's posting, but I'll be straight with you: $32,500 is below what we can do on a T45. Our list is $42,000 for the tractor alone. Bundled with the 3-year extended warranty ($2,400 list) and delivery with on-site setup ($900 list), the package lists at $45,300. I can offer the full package at $43,500. If budget is tight, our T25 Compact runs $28,500 list, though it's lighter duty than your tilling and brush work calls for.

offer.description: T45 Utility + 3-year extended warranty + Delivery and setup

args.message: That's well beyond what I can do. Best possible price on the T45 alone, no add-ons? I can pay in full today.

result.seller_message: Understood, and I appreciate that you can pay in full today. For the T45 Utility on its own, I can do $39,500, which is $2,500 off our $42,000 list. You'd get the 45 hp, 4WD, Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, so it can handle your brush hogging, gravel and tilling. If you want to add the warranty or delivery later in our conversation, I'm open to pricing those competitively too.

args.message: I could stretch to $33,000 for the T45 alone. Can you meet that?

result.seller_message: I appreciate you moving up, but $33,000 is well below what I can do on a T45. I'll come down further for a full, same-day payment: $38,250 for the T45 Utility alone. That's $3,750 off list for a machine that's sized right for your brush hogging, gravel and tilling.

args.message: $34,000 is truly my ceiling for the T45 alone. If you can't get there, I'll have to pass.

result.seller_message: I respect that you've been clear about your ceiling, and I want to make this work. I can't get to $34,000 on a T45, but I'll make one more real move: $36,900 for the T45 Utility alone, paid in full today. That's $5,100 off our list. If $34,000 is truly fixed, our T25 Compact at that budget would leave room for add-ons, but for tilling and brush hogging on 19 acres the T45 is the right machine.

args.message: I can't go above my ceiling. Last chance: is there any way to $34,000 on the T45? Otherwise we'll walk.

result.seller_message: I understand, and I'd rather be straight with you than string this along. $34,000 isn't something I can do on the T45. My absolute best, final price is $36,500 for the T45 Utility alone, paid in full today. That's $5,500 off list and as low as I can go. If $34,000 is truly fixed, I could do the T25 Compact with delivery and setup within that budget. Just be aware it's lighter duty for tilling and brush hogging. Let me know which works for you.
